synopsis.id: Lantai Pasar Badung sering basah, dan lantai atas hanya bisa dicapai lewat tangga. Sepatumu penting di sini.
synopsis.en: Pasar Badung's floor is often wet, and the upper floors are reached only by stairs. What you wear on your feet matters here.

text.id: Lantai pasar sering basah, dan sepatu tertutup yang tidak licin lebih penting di sini dibanding di titik lain sepanjang rute ini.
text.en: The market floor is often wet, and closed, gripping shoes matter more here than anywhere else on this walk.

text.id: Mencapai lantai seni dan kerajinan berarti naik tangga — jumlah anak tangga belum disurvei, dan keberadaan lift pun belum dikonfirmasi.
text.en: Reaching the art and craft floors means climbing — the building's step count has not been surveyed, and a lift has not been confirmed either.

question.id: Apa yang sebaiknya kamu pakai untuk berkeliling Pasar Badung dengan nyaman?
question.en: What should you wear to get around Pasar Badung comfortably?

options.en: It doesn't matter what you wear

explanation.id: Lantai pasar sering basah dan lantai atas hanya dicapai lewat tangga — sandal terbuka adalah pilihan yang salah untuk keduanya.
explanation.en: The market floor is frequently wet and the upper floors are reached only by stairs — open sandals are the wrong choice for either.
